notes.title: Mega Update
notes.content:
I've implemented a substantial game update featuring several noteworthy additions. First and foremost, players will now encounter captivating transition screens that enhance the overall gaming experience. In response to user feedback, I've adjusted the introduction level to be more beginner-friendly, ensuring a smoother entry into the game for newcomers. 🌟

Furthermore, an entirely new category of enemy has been introduced, expanding the diversity of challenges within the game. Within this new enemy type, two unique adversaries have been incorporated: the agile flying snake and the strategic bee boomer, each bringing their own set of skills to test players' abilities. 🐍🐝

To foster a more engaging multiplayer experience, fresh multiplayer levels have been integrated into the game. These levels are designed to provide an exhilarating competitive arena, where players can have a blast engaging in friendly battles against their friends. These new multiplayer challenges add an exciting dimension to the game, offering a thrilling avenue for players to showcase their skills and outmaneuver their peers in a dynamic gaming environment. 🎮💥

Last but not least, I've enriched the game's auditory landscape by introducing a new and captivating musical composition. This addition aims to complement the overall atmosphere of the game and enhance the player's immersion in the virtual world. Get ready to explore these exciting updates and elevate your gaming adventure to new heights! 🎶🚀

A heartfelt thank you to the TOPSWAP community for your continued support! In addition to the exciting features in this update, we've also diligently addressed background bugs. Your feedback is invaluable, and we invite you to join us in perfecting the game further. Together, let's make this gaming experience the best it can be! 🙏🎮

notes.title: TopSwap Game Update v1.7 Release Notes
notes.content:
Greetings, TopSwap players! We're excited to bring you a major update that enhances your multiplayer experience, addresses some pesky bugs, and expands our language support. Let's dive into the details:

New Multiplayer Levels
Get ready to spice up your TopSwap battles with four brand new multiplayer levels! Challenge your friends in diverse environments and test your skills in exciting and strategic showdowns.

Bug Fixes
1. Shooting Push Bug Squashed
We heard your feedback loud and clear! The annoying bug where players experienced a slight push when shooting has been successfully eliminated. Now you can focus on precision shooting without any unexpected disruptions.

2. Multiplayer Life Bug Fixed
We've tackled a tricky bug affecting multiplayer life calculations. Rest assured, your in-game life should now be accurately reflected, ensuring a fair and balanced gaming experience for all players.

Language Expansion
3. German and French Added
TopSwap is now more accessible than ever with the addition of German and French language options. Choose your preferred language in the settings menu and enjoy the game in a language that suits you.

General Improvements
4. Performance Enhancements
We've implemented various performance optimizations to ensure smoother gameplay across all devices. Experience faster load times, improved frame rates, and overall better performance.

5. User Interface Tweaks
We've made subtle but impactful improvements to the user interface, making it more intuitive and user-friendly. Enjoy a seamless navigation experience as you dive into the world of TopSwap.

How to Update
Ensure you have the latest version of TopSwap by visiting your steam and checking for updates. If automatic updates are enabled, you'll receive the new version seamlessly.

Thank you for your continued support and feedback! We hope you enjoy the latest features and improvements in TopSwap v1.7. See you on the battlefield!

notes.title: TopSwap Game Update v1.2 Patch Notes:
notes.content:
Greetings, TopSwap enthusiasts! We're thrilled to bring you the latest update that promises to enhance your gaming experience. We've been hard at work refining various aspects of the game to make it more enjoyable and user-friendly. Here's what's new in version 1.2:

1. Improved Indications:
To assist players in navigating through the game, we've added more intuitive indicators. These will provide better guidance, making it easier for players to strategize and progress through the levels seamlessly.

2. Bug Fixes:
We've squashed a particularly pesky bug that caused an unexpected alien spawn. Rest assured, the extraterrestrial intruders will now adhere to the rules and only appear when intended. Prepare for a smoother, bug-free gaming experience!

3. Level Remaster:
Several levels have undergone a complete makeover. Expect fresh challenges, updated visuals, and refined gameplay elements that will keep you on the edge of your seat. Whether you're a seasoned player or a newcomer, these revamped levels will test your skills and provide a whole new TopSwap adventure.

4. Enhanced Enemy Mechanics:
We've revamped how enemies take damage and manage their life systems. This change adds a layer of depth to the combat system, requiring players to adapt their strategies. Be on the lookout for new ways to tackle foes and exploit their weaknesses.

5. Balanced Enemies:
Enemies are now more balanced to ensure a fair and challenging experience. Harder enemies are still formidable, but we've made adjustments to make them more susceptible to your attacks. Conversely, easier enemies will now pose a greater threat, demanding increased attention and skill to overcome.

6. Strategic Combat Tweaks:
We've fine-tuned the combat dynamics to strike a better balance between offense and defense. Take advantage of the updated combat system to dispatch hard-hitting enemies more efficiently, while being mindful of the increased danger posed by the seemingly easier adversaries.

7. Player Health System Adjustment:
Your survivability is key, and we've adjusted the player's health system to align with the new enemy dynamics. Brace yourself for a more engaging and strategic approach to battles, where every decision could mean the difference between victory and defeat.

8. General Performance Enhancements:
We've made several under-the-hood improvements to enhance overall game performance. Expect smoother gameplay, reduced load times, and a more responsive gaming experience across various devices.

We hope you enjoy these updates and that they elevate your TopSwap experience to new heights. Thank you for your continued support, and may your swapping skills be sharper than ever!

notes.title: TOPSWAP - Update 1.1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Greetings TOPSWAP Players!

We're excited to bring you the latest update (version 1.1) for TOPSWAP, packed with improvements, fixes, and some fresh additions to enhance your gaming experience. Here's what you can expect:

1. Collision Bug Fixes:
We've been hard at work addressing collision issues reported by our vigilant community. Your feedback has been invaluable, and we've squashed those pesky bugs that were causing unexpected collisions. Enjoy smoother gameplay as you navigate through the revamped levels.

2. Level Remaster:
Prepare for a brand-new adventure as many of the levels have undergone a makeover! We've reimagined the environments to provide a more immersive and engaging experience. Get ready to rediscover your favorite challenges with a fresh perspective.

3. New Language Added: Portuguese!
Obrigado, players! We've expanded our language support, and now you can enjoy the game in Portuguese. We appreciate our diverse community and want to make sure everyone can fully enjoy TOPSWAP in their preferred language. Give it a try and let us know what you think!

4. Character Appearance Bug Fix:
Some of you reported characters showing up in levels when they shouldn't. Fear not! We've tracked down the issue and fixed it. Your gameplay will now be free from unwanted appearances, ensuring a seamless and immersive experience.

5. Performance Optimizations:
We've made behind-the-scenes adjustments to improve overall game performance. TOPSWAP should now run even smoother on a variety of systems, providing a more enjoyable gaming experience for all players.

6. General Improvements:
We've listened to your feedback on various aspects of the game and made several general improvements. From minor tweaks to user interface enhancements, we're committed to refining TOPSWAP based on your suggestions.

Thank you for your continued support and feedback. We hope you enjoy playing TOPSWAP with these exciting updates. As always, feel free to share your thoughts with us on the Steam forums or through our support channels. Happy gaming!

Best regards,
David
